adversarial_findings.title: Event dispatched inside DB::transaction — rollback leaves listeners NOT fired
adversarial_findings.severity: P3 (no actual bug — design works as intended)
adversarial_findings.analysis: DispatchableAfterCommit trait (app/Events/Concerns/DispatchableAfterCommit.php:33-39) registers via DB::afterCommit() when transactionLevel() > 0. Rollback drops the closure silently. This is the DESIRED behavior — preventing the WG-2 'phantom broadcast on rollback' class of bugs. Verified semantically correct. The trait is locked by sentinel `tests/Feature/Sync/OrderCreatedDispatchPlacementSentinelTest` per OrderService.php:581.

adversarial_findings.title: Event listener throws → broadcasts already in flight?
adversarial_findings.severity: P2 — empirically mitigated, but no sentinel locks the wrap-discipline
adversarial_findings.analysis: Laravel sync dispatcher (vendor/laravel/framework/src/Illuminate/Events/Dispatcher.php:233-269) halts cascade on listener throw. ALL current listeners wrap body in try/catch envelopes (verified via grep `throw new\|throw \$` returning ZERO in app/Listeners/). A future listener added without the envelope WOULD halt cascade — and the Persist*ToOutbox listener-FIRST positioning mitigates only the canonical order/payment paths. There is no sentinel test that validates wrap-discipline (e.g., AST check that every Listener::handle() top-level body is wrapped in try/catch).
adversarial_findings.remediation: Add `ListenerThrowDisciplineSentinelTest` to Wave Q backlog: scan app/Listeners/*.php, assert each public handle()/__invoke() method body contains a top-level try/catch OR uses isolation_pattern_marker comment.

adversarial_findings.title: Event-loop infinite — Listener dispatches Event A which triggers Listener B which dispatches Event A again
adversarial_findings.severity: P3 — no infinite loop detected, deliberate fan-out exists
adversarial_findings.analysis: Closest pattern: `InvalidateMenuProjectionOnIngredientChange` (listener of IngredientAvailabilityChanged) dispatches CatalogChanged (line 37). CatalogChanged listeners do NOT dispatch IngredientAvailabilityChanged anywhere. Verified via grep. Cascade terminates at PersistCatalogChangedToOutbox. Pattern is intentional fan-out, documented in EventServiceProvider.php:236-238 + InvalidateMenuProjectionOnIngredientChange.php:37-47.
adversarial_findings.secondary_observation: ItemAvailabilityChanged listener PersistCatalogChangedToOutbox writes outbox row with type=CATALOG_CHANGED — NOT MENU_ITEM_AVAILABILITY_CHANGED. The two coexist because PersistItemAvailabilityChangedToOutbox also runs (EventServiceProvider.php:208), writing the typed event. Both flow to broadcast — frontend reconciles via event_type discriminator.

adversarial_findings.title: Queue worker DOWN — what events accumulate without TTL?
adversarial_findings.severity: P1 — only partially mitigated for V1 LOCAL
adversarial_findings.analysis: Outbox: DispatchDomainEventsJob lives on `high` queue. Worker down → DomainEvent row persists with dispatched_at=null. Mitigation ladder: (1) `foodking:outbox:rescue` every minute re-queues attempts<5 (Kernel.php:40-43), (2) `foodking:outbox:monitor --threshold=10` every minute raises Log::error + non-zero exit (Kernel.php:50-53), (3) `foodking:outbox:retry-failed --since=24h` hourly picks up terminal failures (Kernel.php:64-69), (4) `foodking:outbox:prune --older-than-days=90` daily caps growth (Kernel.php:119+). V1 LOCAL has no pager — operator must monitor outbox:monitor exit code via supervisor. NotificationSend* events (12 events) use Laravel notifications via the default queue connection — `QUEUE_CONNECTION=sync` per CLAUDE.md §8 production-boot-guard semantics in V1 LOCAL fires synchronously inside the HTTP request → no accumulation risk in V1 but FCM/SMS failures become user-visible latency.
adversarial_findings.v1_residual_risk: If outbox:monitor cron itself fails to run (cron daemon down), the third defense layer goes silent. Wave Q backlog: external healthcheck (e.g., systemd timer with mail-on-failure) for the schedule:run process.

adversarial_findings.title: Persisted outbox row but channel/broadcast_as NULL — silent drop
adversarial_findings.analysis: DispatchDomainEventsJob.php:100 guards `$domainEvent->channel !== null && $domainEvent->broadcast_as !== null` — if either is null, broadcast skipped silently after the dispatched_at claim is committed. There's a `warnCatalogChannelsNullIfNeeded` helper referenced in ItemService.php:396 + ComposerProfileService.php — same pattern likely elsewhere. The current EventContract.php:55-76 REQUIRED_PAYLOAD_KEYS enforcement runs at broadcast time (after the row exists), so a malformed listener that sets channel=null would still create the row but never broadcast. This silently goes to dispatched_at=now() AND payload-invalid path is NOT triggered.
adversarial_findings.remediation: Add DB-level NOT NULL on `domain_events.channel` + `broadcast_as` if no legitimate use case for null exists (verify via SELECT COUNT(*) FROM domain_events WHERE channel IS NULL OR broadcast_as IS NULL across history before NOT-NULLing).

adversarial_findings.title: OutboxBroadcastSwallowedEvent doc-stale claim 'intentionally unwired'
adversarial_findings.analysis: app/Events/OutboxBroadcastSwallowedEvent.php:26-31 PHPDoc says 'Intentionally **unwired** (no listener registered in EventServiceProvider)' — but EventServiceProvider.php:303-305 registers EscalateOutboxBroadcastSwallowed as a listener since HEAL B.2 2026-05-19.
adversarial_findings.remediation: 1-line doc fix on OutboxBroadcastSwallowedEvent.php:26 — change to 'Wired to EscalateOutboxBroadcastSwallowed since HEAL B.2 2026-05-19. SaaS V1.0.2 can replace with provider-specific bridge'.

adversarial_findings.title: DispatchableAfterCommit semantics differ if event(new X) used instead of X::dispatch()
adversarial_findings.analysis: Trait only intercepts STATIC dispatch (X::dispatch()) — not the `event(new X)` function-helper path which Laravel routes directly through the event dispatcher with no after-commit check. 7 sites in app/Services/* use `event(new X)` but ALL are properly wrapped in DB::afterCommit() (verified via grep correlation). 2 CLI command sites (MenuHealLightV3Command.php:590 + MenuHealLightV31BurgerCommand.php:477) use `event(new CatalogChanged)` OUTSIDE any transaction — semantically equivalent to dispatch() at transactionLevel=0 (no risk in CLI context).
adversarial_findings.footgun_risk: Future contributor copies `event(new ItemUpdated($id))` from ItemService.php:392 WITHOUT the surrounding DB::afterCommit wrapper → silent before-commit broadcast. No sentinel test currently catches this.
adversarial_findings.remediation: Wave Q backlog: rename trait method to make `event(new X)` callable into a static factory pattern, OR add AST sentinel that detects `event(new <TraitUserClass>)` outside DB::afterCommit closures.
